releaseNotes: NEW: the icon editor is now a proper crop screen — dark 'Edit Image' editor with a square 1:1 crop window, rule-of-thirds grid, pinch/drag to position, a zoom slider with live percentage, and Rotate + Shape buttons (Shape previews how launchers mask your icon: square / rounded / squircle / circle)

FIXED: the 'Developed by Deadlock Studio' credit on clone loading screens was getting cut in half on Android 12+ phones (the splash logo is circle-masked there). It now sits in the always-visible centre of the splash and shows completely, including the last letters

NEW APP in the Products tab: Cool Widgets by Deadlock Studio — 12 home screen widgets in 7 categories (digital & analog clocks, big date, countdowns, battery ring, weather for any city, sticky notes, daily quotes, flashlight, search, settings shortcuts, photo frames). Only 2 permissions total, both explained in the app
Engine: the credit-strip downscaler now samples every source pixel exactly once (integer rounding used to drop the right edge of the text)
